theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K O : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → f '' K ⊆ U → ∃ Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) ∧ IsCompact Q.support ∧ Q.support ⊆ f '' K
